sealed_before_running: 2026-10-28 (coordinator order after the architecture contract of the heuristic-strategy README, section 'Strategy architecture and design method'); none of the panels below has been run when this file is committed

D3_unseen_confirmation.never_used_before: seeds 0-2 are the development / qualification seeds; 3-5 were never generated in any matrix, DEAP subset or diagnostic
D3_unseen_confirmation.cells: every base cell of the matrix queue, perfect heads, with its zero-cost twin and exact mirror at the first seed

arms.deap_no_reversal: the DEAP point with allow_reverse = 0 (D6 variant)

D3_unseen_confirmation.paired_statistic: per base cell: mean over seeds of the daily Sharpe and of the net USD; paired difference deap - canonical; 95 % bootstrap CI over base cells (10000 resamples, seed 20261028)
D3_unseen_confirmation.claim_rule: an improvement is claimed only if the CI lower bound is > 0; otherwise the report states 'no demonstrated gain'
D3_unseen_confirmation.qualification_rule: the matrix verdict on seeds 3-5 (governing forms, VALIDITY_SPEC) is reported next to seeds 0-2; a cell that passes on 0-2 and fails on 3-5 is listed as a generalisation failure
D3_unseen_confirmation.verdict_rule_v2: manifest completeness first: every base cell of the manifest x every declared seed present in BOTH folders (missing -> NOT_EVALUABLE, listed); paired identity: the same strategy parameter sha256 and strategy code sha256 in every record of both folders, record seeds equal to the declared seeds; a non-finite paired difference is listed as NOT_EVALUABLE, never dropped; the claim rule applies only to a complete, identity-checked, all-finite panel (GM18)

D4_seeded_positions.construction: an order opened age bars before the seeding tick with the strategy's envelope on a clean engine; the episode starts at the seeding tick in the stated P&L state; the closer alone decides (opener frozen)

expected.sl_destined_closed_before_sl: >= 0.95 per (age, state, side) with >= 30 SL-destined episodes
expected.normalized_regret: mean <= 0.10 and p90 <= 0.30 per (age, state, side)
expected.no_post_termination_extrema: V*(t) searches only up to the first automatic termination (SL / TP / compulsory exit); asserted by construction and by a fixture

D4_seeded_positions.verdict_rule_v2: per declared stratum (age x state x side, every one listed): PASS / FAIL on the regret bounds; the SL-destined rate check is NOT_EVALUABLE below 30 SL-destined episodes (never PASS); an empty stratum is NOT_EVALUABLE (listed, never omitted); reversal-then-recovery with n = 0 is NOT_EVALUABLE (GM18)

D4_reversal_then_recovery.selection: episodes whose path first moves >= 0.5 sigma against the position and then reaches TP or a net >= +0.5 sigma before any SL

expected.profitable_hold: the closer's premature-exit regret mean <= 0.10 normalized and its early-close share <= O*'s + 0.05 on these episodes

D4_negative_controls.construction: for each intervention I in {permuted, swapped, delayed k = 1 / 3 / 6} the EXPECTATION is produced independently of the strategy: the TRUTH ORACLE (PolicyOracle on the engine-truth table, zero margins) run under the SAME intervention of its inputs (same permutation seed, swapped side channels, same delay) on the same world; its daily Sharpe S_orc(I) and net are the reference
D4_negative_controls.expected: per cell and intervention: |S_strategy(I) - S_orc(I)| <= delta, delta = max(1.0, 0.25 x |S_orc(base)|) daily-Sharpe units (declared before the v2 panel runs); the strategy under a damaged input must land where the optimal decision-maker under the same damage lands: not far better (it ignores the channel) and not far worse
D4_negative_controls.not_evaluable: the construction or the strategy run did not produce a finite Sharpe

diagnostics.delayed_sharpe_by_k: reported as a column; monotonicity in the delay is NOT a witness (GM12)

permuted_outputs.how: every head output row-permuted inside the block (one fixed permutation, seed 20261028)
permuted_outputs.expected: net USD within [-1.5, -0.5] x total trading costs (permuted signals lose about the costs); daily Sharpe <= 0

swapped_direction_channels.how: long and short head outputs swapped
swapped_direction_channels.expected: net USD < 0 on every trend cell (mirrored losses); in each trend cell the swapped net is <= -0.5 x the unswapped net

delayed_outputs.how: every head output delayed by 1, 3 and 6 bars (the value of t - k used at t)
delayed_outputs.expected: daily Sharpe non-increasing in the delay (0 >= 1 >= 3 >= 6, tolerance 0.05) and Sharpe(6) < Sharpe(0)

D5_metrics.normalized_regret: regret_USD / initial_cash_risk_at_SL, the denominator = units x |entry price - SL| frozen at entry (> 0; a zero or invalid risk is a contract error); sigma-unit regret stays as the secondary form
D5_metrics.V_star: V*(t) = max(executable discretionary closes before the first automatic termination, N_auto(tau) of that termination) -- the exit spec's P* / A(t) already include the natural exit
D5_metrics.tie_policy: declared deviation from the README example ('earliest executable optimum'): a close is optimal when A(t) >= -EPS_CLOSE (0.02 sigma of the trade); the same EPS everywhere (E3 / E4 / O* / W4_v3)

D6_reversal.declared_variant: allow_reverse = 1 is the engine's close-and-reverse rule (A4-1: one close plus one entry on the same tick, both costed); it is a DECLARED VARIANT, not the README's initial single-position design
D6_reversal.reported_next_to_it: the no-reversal variant (allow_reverse = 0, the v10 canonical) in D3

D7_closer_quality_vs_information_limited.sealed_before_running: 2026-10-28 (coordinator order: the closer was destructive in 73-96 % of its closes at q0.85 / q0.70 under an unbiased per-tick-independent noise model)
D7_closer_quality_vs_information_limited.head_noise_model: calibrated conditional mean (rho_h^2 shrinkage toward the calibration-block mean of BC) with a heteroscedastic predictive sd s_hat; errors AR(1) across ticks, phi measured = 0.587 (median lag-1 autocorrelation of the H6 errors of the 24 committed hourly prediction CSVs, predictor examples/results phase_1 and phase_3_1); sensitivity phi in {0, 0.587, 0.98}
D7_closer_quality_vs_information_limited.strategy_rule: close when A_hat - z_close x s_hat >= -closer_adv_margin on k_persist consecutive executable ticks (genes z_close in [0, 3], k_persist in [1, 6]); broker SL the backstop
D7_closer_quality_vs_information_limited.reference: the INFORMATION-LIMITED ORACLE: a Bayes closer that sees the same noisy head stream and knows the noise model (a 2-state Kalman filter per position: A random walk with per-tick variance sd_BC^2 / 24, the AR(1) error), closing iff E[A(t) | head history] >= -EPS_CLOSE

expected_per_family_and_side.regret: mean (P* - P(exit)) / initial cash risk at SL <= Bayes + 0.05
expected_per_family_and_side.early_close_value: sum over SL-destined trades closed early of (P(exit) - hold-to-SL) > 0

D7_closer_quality_vs_information_limited.perfect_heads: the perfect-head thresholds stay as sealed (EXIT_SPEC); at q1.00 (s_hat = 0, k_persist = 1) the rule reproduces the perfect-head results exactly

diagnostics_not_witnesses.monotone_in_quality: E4 and regret non-decreasing as quality falls 1.00 -> 0.85 -> 0.70 (tolerance 0.02) -- DIAGNOSTIC column (GM12): for a fixed controller, noise can accidentally improve a biased decision and a worse closer can raise account turnover; non-monotonicity is reported, never a defect by itself

D7_closer_quality_vs_information_limited.reference_status: named COMPARATOR, not an upper bound (GM19): its process variance sd_BC^2 / 24 is ~12x below the variance estimated on the calibration block (closer_ladder_filter); repaired comparators are new identities

comparators.bayes: the information-limited Bayes closer (named comparator, not a bound; GM19)
comparators.fixed_delay: the fixed-delay closer whose delay is selected on the CALIBRATION block only (mean cash-risk-normalized regret over immediate .. 48 executable ticks and passive hold; a native termination before the delay keeps its own result; Musashi finding 110); reported per quality / phi next to the strategy and the Bayes closer; a strategy closer that does not beat it on regret is reported as such
